#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""AI 세션 로그 수집기 명령줄 (AI-LOG-001).

사용법 (저장소 루트에서, python -I scripts/ai_logging/cli.py <명령>):
  수집·검증
    install                 치환 목록(값 출력 없음)·로컬 제외·Git hook 런타임 설치 후 수집
    sync                    두 도구 원본 → 마스킹·검증 → ai-logs/live/ (로컬 확인용, 커밋 안 함)
    verify [--final]        live 사본 검사(읽기 전용). --final: 원본 끝까지·누락 세션까지 실패 처리
    status                  수집·턴·hook·예약 작업·제출 완전성 요약
    index                   세션을 첫 시각(UTC) 순으로 나열
    holds / mask-held <목록지문> <번호>...   보류 후보(형태만) / 고른 값 치환 목록 추가
    repair-live <tool/sid>  손상된 live manifest를 보관 이름으로 옮겨 다음 수집이 다시 쓰게 함(사용자 실행)
  스냅샷·제출
    snapshot                전체 세션 불변 스냅샷 생성(커밋 안 함)
    completeness [REV]      REV(기본: 작업 폴더) 스냅샷이 원본 끝까지 담았는지 검사
    live-covered            live 사본 ⊆ 스냅샷 확인(live 제외 정책 전환 전)
    submit [작업ID]          모든 AI 응답이 끝난 뒤: 전체 스냅샷 → 현재 브랜치에 로그 전용 커밋
  턴 보호·예약 작업
    turns                   세션별 턴 상태(active/idle/unknown)와 근거
    turns resolve <tool/sid> <idle|unknown>   멈춘 세션을 사람이 확인한 뒤 지정(사용자 실행)
    task reserve commit --message-file F -- <경로>...
    task reserve squash --onto <REV> --message-file F
    task reserve stage-log <작업ID> [단계 이름]
    task reserve <push-develop|resume|merge-feature> <feature>
    task list | task run | task cancel <ID> | task retry <ID>
  브랜치 흐름 (사용자 실행)
    new-feature <ID>        master에서 feature/<ID> 생성(로깅 설정 확인, 동시 feature 1개)
    push-develop <feature> [--no-push]   develop 로그 커밋 → 로그 전용 커밋만 master 반영 → atomic push
    resume <feature>        최신 master(로그 전용 변경)를 feature에 일반 병합
    merge-feature <feature> 꼬리 로그 커밋 → feature를 로컬 master에 --no-ff 병합·검증(push 안 함)
  hook 진입점 (설정에서만 호출)
    hook <claude|codex> <Event>
    githook commit-msg <파일> | githook pre-push <remote> <url>

종료 코드: 0 정상, 1 보류·실패, 2 사용법 오류. hook 명령은 항상 0(UserPromptSubmit 보호 실패만 2).
"""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

from ailog import engine  # noqa: E402
from ailog.common import default_context  # noqa: E402


def _utf8_stdout():
    """파이프·파일로 나가는 출력은 UTF-8로 고정한다.

    Windows의 Python은 파이프 출력에 시스템 코드 페이지(CP949)를 쓴다. 그러면 Git·IDE·Claude/Codex처럼
    UTF-8로 읽는 쪽에서 한글이 깨진다(Git hook·프롬프트 차단 사유 포함). 콘솔(tty)은 Python이 유니코드로
    직접 쓰므로 그대로 둔다.
    """
    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
        try:
            if stream is not None and not stream.isatty():
                stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except (AttributeError, ValueError, OSError):
            pass


def _print_problems(items, limit=30):
    for p in items[:limit]:
        loc = p.get("file", "")
        if "line" in p:
            loc += f":{p['line']}"
        print(f"    - [{p['rule']}] {p.get('session', '')} {loc} {p.get('detail', '')}".rstrip())
    if len(items) > limit:
        print(f"    ... 외 {len(items) - limit}건")


def _print_sync(r):
    print(f"수집 결과: {r['result']}  (정책 {r['policy_version']}, {r['time']})")
    for s in r["sessions"]:
        if s.get("status") == "original_missing":
            print(f"  {s['key']}: 원본을 찾을 수 없음 (사본 보존, 제출 보류 대상)")
            continue
        extra = ""
        if s.get("status") == "hold":
            extra = f" 보류 {s.get('problems')}건, 미반영 {s.get('pending_bytes')} bytes"
        else:
            extra = f" {s.get('lines')}줄 {s.get('original_bytes')} bytes, {s.get('first_timestamp')} ~ {s.get('last_timestamp')}"
        print(f"  {s['key']}: {s['status']}{extra}")
    if r["holds_total"]:
        print(f"  보류 항목 {r['holds_total']}건 (값은 표시하지 않음):")
        _print_problems(r["holds"])
    for e in r["errors"]:
        print(f"  오류: {e}")
    if r.get("unresolved_codex_files"):
        print(f"  참고: 프로젝트 여부를 판정하지 못한 Codex 파일 {r['unresolved_codex_files']}개(다른 프로젝트일 수 있음)")


def _print_commit_result(r, label):
    if r.get("snapshot"):
        _print_snapshot(r["snapshot"])
    if not r.get("ok"):
        print(f"{label} 중단: {r.get('reason')} {r.get('detail', '') or ''}".rstrip())
        for k, v in sorted((r.get("sessions") or {}).items()):
            print(f"  {k}: {v}")
        return 1
    if r.get("committed"):
        print(f"{label} 완료: {r['commit'][:12]} ({r.get('branch')}, 스냅샷 {r.get('snapshots')}개, 파일 {r.get('files')}개)")
    elif r.get("held"):
        print("새로 커밋할 스냅샷 없음: 보류가 아닌 세션은 이미 최신입니다.")
    else:
        print("변경 없음: 이미 최신 스냅샷이 커밋되어 있습니다.")
    for k, n in sorted((r.get("held") or {}).items()):
        print(f"  보류로 제외: {k} {n}건 (값은 커밋하지 않음)")
    if r.get("held"):
        print("  해소: python -I scripts/ai_logging/cli.py holds → mask-held 또는 허용 목록. 해소 뒤 다음 커밋에 이어서 쌓입니다.")
    return 0


def _print_snapshot(r):
    print(f"스냅샷: {r['result']} (정책 {r.get('policy_version')})")
    for s in r.get("sessions", []):
        extra = f" 꼬리 보류 {s['deferred']}" if s.get("deferred") else ""
        print(f"  {s['key']}: {s['status']} {s['base'].rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]} {s.get('main_lines')}줄{extra}")
    for m in r.get("missing", []):
        print(f"  {m['session']}: 원본 없음 (이전 스냅샷 {'있음' if m['snapshot_kept'] else '없음'})")
    if r.get("holds"):
        print(f"  보류 {len(r['holds'])}건 (값은 표시하지 않음):")
        _print_problems(r["holds"])
    for w in r.get("warnings", []):
        print(f"  경고: {w['rule']} {w.get('session', '')} {w.get('file', '')} {w.get('detail', '')}".rstrip())

def _utf8_stdout():
    """파이프·파일로 나가는 출력은 UTF-8로 고정한다.

    Windows의 Python은 파이프 출력에 시스템 코드 페이지(CP949)를 쓴다. 그러면 Git·IDE·Claude/Codex처럼
    UTF-8로 읽는 쪽에서 한글이 깨진다(Git hook·프롬프트 차단 사유 포함). 콘솔(tty)은 Python이 유니코드로
    직접 쓰므로 그대로 둔다.
    """
    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
        try:
            if stream is not None and not stream.isatty():
                stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except (AttributeError, ValueError, OSError):
            pass


def _print_problems(items, limit=30):
    for p in items[:limit]:
        loc = p.get("file", "")
        if "line" in p:
            loc += f":{p['line']}"
        print(f"    - [{p['rule']}] {p.get('session', '')} {loc} {p.get('detail', '')}".rstrip())
    if len(items) > limit:
        print(f"    ... 외 {len(items) - limit}건")


def _print_sync(r):
    print(f"수집 결과: {r['result']}  (정책 {r['policy_version']}, {r['time']})")
    for s in r["sessions"]:
        if s.get("status") == "original_missing":
            print(f"  {s['key']}: 원본을 찾을 수 없음 (사본 보존, 제출 보류 대상)")
            continue
        extra = ""
        if s.get("status") == "hold":
            extra = f" 보류 {s.get('problems')}건, 미반영 {s.get('pending_bytes')} bytes"
        else:
            extra = f" {s.get('lines')}줄 {s.get('original_bytes')} bytes, {s.get('first_timestamp')} ~ {s.get('last_timestamp')}"
        print(f"  {s['key']}: {s['status']}{extra}")
    if r["holds_total"]:
        print(f"  보류 항목 {r['holds_total']}건 (값은 표시하지 않음):")
        _print_problems(r["holds"])
    for e in r["errors"]:
        print(f"  오류: {e}")
    if r.get("unresolved_codex_files"):
        print(f"  참고: 프로젝트 여부를 판정하지 못한 Codex 파일 {r['unresolved_codex_files']}개(다른 프로젝트일 수 있음)")


def _print_commit_result(r, label):
    if r.get("snapshot"):
        _print_snapshot(r["snapshot"])
    if not r.get("ok"):
        print(f"{label} 중단: {r.get('reason')} {r.get('detail', '') or ''}".rstrip())
        for k, v in sorted((r.get("sessions") or {}).items()):
            print(f"  {k}: {v}")
        return 1
    if r.get("committed"):
        print(f"{label} 완료: {r['commit'][:12]} ({r.get('branch')}, 스냅샷 {r.get('snapshots')}개, 파일 {r.get('files')}개)")
    elif r.get("held"):
        print("새로 커밋할 스냅샷 없음: 보류가 아닌 세션은 이미 최신입니다.")
    else:
        print("변경 없음: 이미 최신 스냅샷이 커밋되어 있습니다.")
    for k, n in sorted((r.get("held") or {}).items()):
        print(f"  보류로 제외: {k} {n}건 (값은 커밋하지 않음)")
    if r.get("held"):
        print("  해소: python -I scripts/ai_logging/cli.py holds → mask-held 또는 허용 목록. 해소 뒤 다음 커밋에 이어서 쌓입니다.")
    return 0


def _print_snapshot(r):
    print(f"스냅샷: {r['result']} (정책 {r.get('policy_version')})")
    for s in r.get("sessions", []):
        extra = f" 꼬리 보류 {s['deferred']}" if s.get("deferred") else ""
        print(f"  {s['key']}: {s['status']} {s['base'].rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]} {s.get('main_lines')}줄{extra}")
    for m in r.get("missing", []):
        print(f"  {m['session']}: 원본 없음 (이전 스냅샷 {'있음' if m['snapshot_kept'] else '없음'})")
    if r.get("holds"):
        print(f"  보류 {len(r['holds'])}건 (값은 표시하지 않음):")
        _print_problems(r["holds"])
    for w in r.get("warnings", []):
        print(f"  경고: {w['rule']} {w.get('session', '')} {w.get('file', '')} {w.get('detail', '')}".rstrip())

"""Collect and check production logs without Git mutation or raw-value output."""
import json
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts" / "ai_logging"))
from ailog import engine, gitops, metadata, snapshot, turns
from ailog.common import default_context, sha256, utc_now
from ailog.discover import resolve_targets

ctx = default_context()
report = {"started": utc_now(), "final_remote_submission": False}

def rules(items):
    return dict(Counter(x["rule"] for x in items))

def saved_bytes():
    files = [p for p in Path(ctx.snapshots_dir).rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
    files += [p for p in (Path(ctx.state_dir) / "metadata-history").rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
    return {str(p): sha256(p.read_bytes()) for p in files}

before = saved_bytes()
print("Collecting complete local copies", flush=True)
sync = engine.sync(ctx)
report["sync"] = {"result": sync["result"], "holds": sync["holds_total"],
                  "rules": rules(sync["holds"]), "errors": len(sync["errors"]),
                  "sessions": [{"key": s["key"], "status": s["status"]} for s in sync["sessions"]]}
print(json.dumps(report["sync"]), flush=True)
print("Creating immutable snapshots", flush=True)
snaps = snapshot.snapshot_all(ctx, states=turns.effective_states(ctx))
report["policy_version"] = snaps["policy_version"]
report["snapshots"] = {"result": snaps["result"], "holds": len(snaps["holds"]),
                       "rules": rules(snaps["holds"]), "sessions": snaps["sessions"]}
print("Checking live copies and snapshot completeness", flush=True)
verify = engine.verify(ctx, final=True)
report["verify"] = {"ok": verify["ok"], "sessions": verify["sessions_collected"],
                    "files": verify["files_checked"], "rules": rules(verify["failures"])}
complete = snapshot.completeness(ctx, None)
report["completeness"] = {"complete": complete["complete"], "rules": rules(complete["failures"])}
covered = snapshot.live_covered(ctx)
report["live_covered"] = {"covered": covered["covered"], "rules": rules(covered.get("failures", []))}
print("Checking preserved histories and committed snapshots", flush=True)
rows = []
for session in resolve_targets(ctx, engine.load_state(ctx)).sessions:
    manifest = json.loads((Path(ctx.live_dir) / session.tool / session.session_id / "manifest.json").read_bytes())
    archive, problems = metadata.archives(ctx, session)
    history = [e for e in manifest["files"] if e.get("role") == metadata.ROLE]
    rows.append({"session": session.key, "history_versions": len(history), "archives": len(archive),
                 "archive_rules": rules(problems)})
report["metadata"] = rows
report["prior_files_checked"] = len(before)
report["prior_files_changed_or_missing"] = sum(not Path(p).is_file() or sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()) != h
                                               for p, h in before.items())
master = gitops.rev(ctx.root, "master")
report["master"] = master
report["master_secret_findings"] = len(snapshot.scan_tree_secrets(ctx, master))
master_files = gitops.tree_files(ctx.root, master, "ai-logs/snapshots")
dev_files = gitops.tree_files(ctx.root, "develop", "ai-logs/snapshots")
report["develop_snapshot_files"] = len(dev_files)
report["develop_missing_or_different_in_master"] = sum(master_files.get(p) != e for p, e in dev_files.items())
report["finished"] = utc_now()
(Path(__file__).parent / "finalization-verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(report), flush=True)
ok = (sync["result"] == "ok" and snaps["result"] == "ok" and verify["ok"] and complete["complete"]
      and covered["covered"] and not report["prior_files_changed_or_missing"] and not report["master_secret_findings"]
      and not any(row["archive_rules"] for row in rows))
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)

def install_runtime(ctx: Context) -> dict:
    """hook 스크립트·수집기 사본을 런타임 폴더에 복사하고 core.hooksPath를 지정한 뒤 실제 실행을 확인한다."""
    # 실행 중인 수집기 코드를 그대로 복사한다(작업 폴더 → 런타임).
    src_pkg = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    src_hooks = os.path.join(ctx.root, ".githooks")
    if not os.path.isdir(src_hooks):
        src_hooks = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(src_pkg)), ".githooks")
    rt = runtime_dir(ctx)
    staging = rt + ".new"
    shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
    shutil.copytree(src_pkg, os.path.join(staging, "ai_logging"),
                    ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc"))
    ensure_dir(os.path.join(staging, "hooks"))
    for name in HOOK_NAMES:
        with open(os.path.join(src_hooks, name), "rb") as f:
            data = f.read().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
        dst = os.path.join(staging, "hooks", name)
        with open(dst, "wb") as f:
            f.write(data)
        os.chmod(dst, 0o755)
    old = rt + ".old"
    shutil.rmtree(old, ignore_errors=True)
    if os.path.isdir(rt):
        os.replace(rt, old)
    os.replace(staging, rt)
    shutil.rmtree(old, ignore_errors=True)
    hooks_path = os.path.join(rt, "hooks").replace("\\", "/")
    gitops.git_run(ctx.root, "config", "core.hooksPath", hooks_path)
    return dict({"hooks_path": hooks_path}, **verify_runtime(ctx))

        empty = os.path.join(d, "empty")

        r = gitops.git_run(ctx.root, "hook", "run", f"--to-stdin={empty}", "pre-push", "--", "origin", "x",

        out["pre_push_runs"] = r.returncode == 0
        dele = os.path.join(d, "delete")
        main = config.load(ctx)["main"]
        with open(dele, "wb") as f:
            f.write(f"(delete) {gitops.ZERO} refs/heads/{main} {'1' * 40}\n".encode())
        r = gitops.git_run(ctx.root, "hook", "run", f"--to-stdin={dele}", "pre-push", "--", "origin", "x",
                           check=False, timeout=120)
        out["pre_push_rejects_master_delete"] = r.returncode != 0 and b"master_delete_refused" in r.stderr

    rng = [f"{base}..{tip}"] if base else [tip, "--not", f"--remotes={remote}"]
    out = []

        if len(gitops.parents(root, c)) == 1 and not _is_log_commit(root, c):
            out.append(c)
    return out


def _last_source_commit(root: str, head: str) -> str | None:
    for c in (gitops.git(root, "rev-list", "--first-parent", head) or "").split():
        if not _is_log_commit(root, c):
            return c
    return None

| 항목 | 내용 |
| --- | --- |
| 분류 | 공통 기준 |
| 상태 | 현재 · 적용 예정 사항은 해당 절에서 구분 |
| 목적 | Kotlin·Spring·JPA 코드를 같은 방식으로 쓰기 위한 규칙 |
| 범위 | `services/**/*.kt`, `build-logic/**/*.kt` |
| 관련 코드 | `build-logic/src/main/kotlin/task.spring-service.gradle.kts`(컴파일 옵션·allOpen) |

포맷은 [formatting](formatting.md)이 정하고 빌드가 검사한다. 이 문서는 포맷으로 정할 수 없는 규칙을 다룬다.

## POL-CODE-001 Kotlin

- `val`을 기본으로 쓰고, 변경이 필요할 때만 `var`를 쓴다.
- 필수 값의 null 가능성은 경계(요청·설정·외부 응답)에서 검증하고, 안쪽에서는 null이 아닌 타입으로 바꾼다. 계약상 선택 정보는 내부 조회 모델에서도 부재 의미를 보존한다(예: 소속 시각·과금 정보). 임의 기본값으로 필수 누락이나 미확인 정보를 숨기지 않는다.
  - `!!`를 쓰지 않는다. `requireNotNull`·`checkNotNull`로 이유가 드러나게 한다.
- 컴파일 옵션 `-Xjsr305=strict`: Spring의 null 표시를 Kotlin 타입으로 엄격하게 받는다.
- 컴파일 옵션 `-Xannotation-default-target=param-property`: 생성자 속성의 애너테이션이 파라미터와 속성 모두에 붙는다.
  - Bean Validation 애너테이션은 대상을 분명히 하려고 `@field:`로 쓴다.
- 공개 API(클래스·함수)에는 목적과 정책 ID를 KDoc으로 남긴다. 구현을 되풀이하는 주석은 쓰지 않는다.

## POL-CODE-002 Spring

- 의존성은 생성자 주입만 쓴다(필드 주입·`lateinit` 주입 금지, 테스트 제외).
- 설정 클래스는 `@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)`.
- 설정값은 `@ConfigurationProperties` + `@Validated`로 받고, 기동 시 검증한다. 필수값이 없으면 기동하지 않는다.
  - `@EnableConfigurationProperties`로 쓰는 설정 클래스에서만 등록한다. 전체 스캔(`@ConfigurationPropertiesScan`)은 쓰지 않는다. 프로필 전용 설정이 다른 프로필에서 검증되지 않게 하기 위해서다.
- 프로필: 기본(운영 가정), `local`(로컬 개발 주소 기본값). 프로필별 차이는 `application-<프로필>.yaml`에 둔다.
- 비밀값은 설정 파일에 쓰지 않는다. 파일로 주입한다([POL-SEC-004](security.md#pol-sec-004-키비밀번호)).

## POL-CODE-003 JPA

- 엔티티는 `data class`로 만들지 않는다. `equals`·`hashCode`는 식별자 기준으로 직접 정의한다.
- 엔티티는 프록시를 위해 open이어야 한다. `build-logic`의 `allOpen`이 `@Entity`·`@MappedSuperclass`·`@Embeddable`을 자동으로 연다. 기본 생성자는 `plugin.jpa`가 만든다.
- 스키마는 Flyway만 바꾼다. `ddl-auto`는 `validate`다([POL-DATA-002](data-conventions.md#pol-data-002-flyway)).
- `open-in-view`는 끈다. 지연 로딩은 트랜잭션 안에서 끝낸다.
- 다른 서비스의 엔티티와 JPA 관계를 맺지 않는다. 식별자 값만 저장한다([POL-DATA-003](data-conventions.md#pol-data-003-다른-서비스-데이터)).

## POL-CODE-004 예외·로그

- 예상한 실패는 의미 있는 예외로 던지고, 오류 응답 변환은 `presentation/error`에서 한다([POL-API-002](api-conventions.md#pol-api-002-오류-응답)).
- 처리되지 않은 예외는 ERROR로 남기고, 응답에는 내부 메시지를 넣지 않는다.
- 로그에 토큰·비밀번호·개인정보를 남기지 않는다. 다른 서비스 호출 로그에는 방법·경로·예외 종류만 남긴다.
- 예외(사용자 결정, REVIEW-002): 그룹 summary의 중복 멤버 ID는 원문을 WARN `event=input.duplicate_ids`에 남긴다. 중복 ID 목록·중복 수·요청 수·고유 수만 쓰고 키·본문·다른 입력은 넣지 않는다. 그 밖의 멤버 ID는 계속 로그에 남기지 않는다.

## POL-CODE-005 enum 코드

코드·상태를 나타내는 enum은 값의 의미를 코드 안에서 이해할 수 있도록 다음 필드를 명시한다.

| 필드 | 역할 | 오류 enum 예시 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | 외부 계약·저장에 사용하는 안정적인 코드 문자열 | `UNAUTHORIZED` |
| `status` | 해당 코드의 상태. 오류에서는 HTTP 상태 번호 | `401` |
| `codeName` | 사람이 읽는 한국어 코드명 | 인증 필요 |

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts" / "ai_logging"))
from ailog import gitops
from ailog.common import default_context, sha256, utc_now

ctx = default_context()
paths = [
    "config/ai-logs-allowlist.json",
    "docs/common/ai-logging.md",
    "docs/tasks/REVIEW-001/decisions.md",
    "docs/tasks/REVIEW-002/plan.md",
    "docs/verification/REVIEW-002/log-holds.md",
    "docs/verification/REVIEW-002/verification.md",
    "scripts/ai_logging/ailog/common.py",

    "scripts/ai_logging/ailog/rules.py",

    "tests/test_metadata_history.py",
]

compile((HERE / "finish-submission.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "finish-submission.py", "exec")
plan = {"time": utc_now(), "files": {p: sha256((ROOT / p).read_bytes()) for p in paths},

"""User-run REVIEW-002 final handoff. --check is read-only; --apply requires idle turns.

Commits the reviewed files on the feature, validates develop, refreshes hooks,
merges the feature into master, publishes logs, then verifies the remote SHA.
No reset, stash, force push, hook bypass, or original-session writes.
"""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts" / "ai_logging"))
from ailog import engine, flows, githooks, gitops, rules, snapshot, tasks, turns
from ailog.common import default_context, sha256, utc_now

ctx = default_context()
FEATURE = "feature/REVIEW-002"


def require(condition, reason):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(reason)


def git(*args):
    # Fixed commands and explicit argument arrays; never interpolate shell text.
    result = subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True)
    require(result.returncode == 0, "git_failed:" + args[0] + ":exit=" + str(result.returncode))
    return result.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()


def checked(result, label):
    require(result.get("ok"), label + ":" + str(result.get("reason", "failed")))
    print(label + ": ok", flush=True)
    return result


def nonlog(rev):
    return {p: v for p, v in gitops.tree_files(ctx.root, rev).items() if not rules.is_log_path(p)}


def preflight(plan):
    require(not gitops.in_progress(ctx.root), "git_operation_in_progress")
    require(not gitops.staged_changes(ctx.root), "staged_changes_present")
    require(gitops.current_branch(ctx.root) == "develop", "start_on_develop_required")
    require(set(gitops.worktree_dirty(ctx.root)) == set(plan["files"]), "changed_path_set_differs_from_review")
    for path, digest in plan["files"].items():
        require(sha256((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == digest, "reviewed_file_changed:" + path)
    for branch in (FEATURE, "master"):
        require(gitops.rev(ctx.root, branch) == plan["heads"][branch], "branch_changed:" + branch)
    dev = gitops.rev(ctx.root, "develop")
    require(gitops.is_ancestor(ctx.root, plan["heads"]["develop"], dev), "develop_diverged")
    extra = git("rev-list", plan["heads"]["develop"] + ".." + dev).split()
    require(all(flows._is_log_commit(ctx.root, commit) for commit in extra), "develop_has_new_source_commits")
    require(nonlog(FEATURE) == nonlog("develop") == nonlog("master"), "baseline_source_trees_differ")
    require(not [t for t in tasks.listing(ctx) if t["status"] in ("pending", "failed")], "reserved_tasks_not_finished")
    return {"reviewed_files": len(plan["files"]), "busy_sessions": len(turns.busy_sessions(ctx)),
            "develop_log_commits_since_review": len(extra)}


def validate_develop():
    commands = [
        ("develop-tests.txt", [sys.executable, "-X", "utf8", "-I", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-v"]),
        ("develop-docs.txt", [sys.executable, "-X", "utf8", "-I", "scripts/verification/docs-check.py"]),
    ]
    for name, command in commands:
        print("Validating " + name, flush=True)
        with (HERE / name).open("wb") as stream:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        require(result.returncode == 0, "validation_failed:" + name)


def complete_at(rev):
    result = snapshot.completeness(ctx, rev)
    require(result["complete"], "incomplete:" + ",".join(sorted({p["rule"] for p in result["failures"]})))
    require(not snapshot.scan_tree_secrets(ctx, rev), "committed_secret_findings")
    return result


def apply(plan):
    with turns.guard_lock(ctx, timeout=20):
        require(not turns.busy_sessions(ctx), "ai_turn_not_idle")
        print(json.dumps(preflight(plan)), flush=True)
        # The old installed hook cannot validate the new metadata-history IDs.
        checked(githooks.install_runtime(ctx), "hook_runtime")
        git("switch", FEATURE)
        message = HERE / "source-message.txt"
        message.write_text("[REVIEW-002] 로그 보류 해소와 종료 메타데이터 이력 보존\n\n"

"""User-run REVIEW-002 final handoff. --check is read-only; --apply requires idle turns.

Commits the reviewed files on the feature, validates develop, refreshes hooks,
merges the feature into master, publishes logs, then verifies the remote SHA.
No reset, stash, force push, hook bypass, or original-session writes.
"""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts" / "ai_logging"))
from ailog import engine, flows, githooks, gitops, rules, snapshot, tasks, turns
from ailog.common import default_context, sha256, utc_now

ctx = default_context()
FEATURE = "feature/REVIEW-002"


def require(condition, reason):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(reason)


def git(*args):
    # Fixed commands and explicit argument arrays; never interpolate shell text.
    result = subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True)
    require(result.returncode == 0, "git_failed:" + args[0] + ":exit=" + str(result.returncode))
    return result.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()


def checked(result, label):
    require(result.get("ok"), label + ":" + str(result.get("reason", "failed")))
    print(label + ": ok", flush=True)
    return result


def nonlog(rev):
    return {p: v for p, v in gitops.tree_files(ctx.root, rev).items() if not rules.is_log_path(p)}


def preflight(plan):
    require(not gitops.in_progress(ctx.root), "git_operation_in_progress")
    require(not gitops.staged_changes(ctx.root), "staged_changes_present")
    require(gitops.current_branch(ctx.root) == "develop", "start_on_develop_required")
    require(set(gitops.worktree_dirty(ctx.root)) == set(plan["files"]), "changed_path_set_differs_from_review")
    for path, digest in plan["files"].items():
        require(sha256((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == digest, "reviewed_file_changed:" + path)
    for branch in (FEATURE, "master"):
        require(gitops.rev(ctx.root, branch) == plan["heads"][branch], "branch_changed:" + branch)
    dev = gitops.rev(ctx.root, "develop")
    require(gitops.is_ancestor(ctx.root, plan["heads"]["develop"], dev), "develop_diverged")
    extra = git("rev-list", plan["heads"]["develop"] + ".." + dev).split()
    require(all(flows._is_log_commit(ctx.root, commit) for commit in extra), "develop_has_new_source_commits")
    require(nonlog(FEATURE) == nonlog("develop") == nonlog("master"), "baseline_source_trees_differ")
    require(not [t for t in tasks.listing(ctx) if t["status"] in ("pending", "failed")], "reserved_tasks_not_finished")
    return {"reviewed_files": len(plan["files"]), "busy_sessions": len(turns.busy_sessions(ctx)),
            "develop_log_commits_since_review": len(extra)}


def validate_develop():
    commands = [
        ("develop-tests.txt", [sys.executable, "-X", "utf8", "-I", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-v"]),
        ("develop-docs.txt", [sys.executable, "-X", "utf8", "-I", "scripts/verification/docs-check.py"]),
    ]
    for name, command in commands:
        print("Validating " + name, flush=True)
        with (HERE / name).open("wb") as stream:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        require(result.returncode == 0, "validation_failed:" + name)


def complete_at(rev):
    result = snapshot.completeness(ctx, rev)
    require(result["complete"], "incomplete:" + ",".join(sorted({p["rule"] for p in result["failures"]})))
    require(not snapshot.scan_tree_secrets(ctx, rev), "committed_secret_findings")
    return result


def apply(plan):
    with turns.guard_lock(ctx, timeout=20):
        require(not turns.busy_sessions(ctx), "ai_turn_not_idle")
        print(json.dumps(preflight(plan)), flush=True)
        # The old installed hook cannot validate the new metadata-history IDs.
        checked(githooks.install_runtime(ctx), "hook_runtime")
        git("switch", FEATURE)
        message = HERE / "source-message.txt"
        message.write_text("[REVIEW-002] 로그 보류 해소와 종료 메타데이터 이력 보존\n\n"
                           "  확인된 29종만 허용하고 2종을 마스킹\n"
                           "  검증된 종료 표시 추가의 과거 사본과 현재 버전을 함께 보존\n"
                           "  수집·완전성·손상·재시도·동시 실행 회귀와 실제 수집 검증\n", encoding="utf-8")
        git("add", "--", *plan["files"])
        git("commit", "-F", str(message))
        source = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
        # The already prepared develop changes have first been committed on the feature.
        # Resume now incorporates remote master before develop review and final merge.
        checked(flows.resume(ctx, FEATURE, guard_held=True), "resume")
        git("switch", "develop")
        merge_message = HERE / "develop-message.txt"
        merge_message.write_text("[REVIEW-002] 로그 보완 develop 반영\n\n  메타데이터 보존과 내용 후보 처리를 검토·검증\n", encoding="utf-8")
        git("merge", "--no-ff", "-F", str(merge_message), FEATURE)
        require(nonlog("develop") == nonlog(FEATURE), "develop_source_differs_from_feature")
        validate_develop()
        require(not gitops.worktree_dirty(ctx.root), "validation_changed_worktree")
        print("Collecting the completed final turn", flush=True)
        collected = engine.sync(ctx)
        require(collected["result"] == "ok" and not collected["missing_sessions"], "log_collection_not_complete")
        made = snapshot.snapshot_all(ctx, states=turns.effective_states(ctx))
        require(made["result"] == "ok" and not made["missing"], "snapshot_not_complete")
        require(engine.verify(ctx, final=True)["ok"], "final_live_verification_failed")
        require(snapshot.completeness(ctx, None)["complete"], "worktree_snapshot_not_complete")
        require(snapshot.live_covered(ctx)["covered"], "live_not_covered")
        checked(flows.merge_feature(ctx, FEATURE, guard_held=True), "merge_feature")
        complete_at("master")
        # Publish the reviewed allowlist first. An old master policy must not evaluate
        # newly collected snapshots before the corresponding policy commit arrives.
        git("push", "origin", "master")
        checked(flows.push_develop(ctx, FEATURE, guard_held=True), "push_develop")
        master = git("rev-parse", "master")
        develop = git("rev-parse", "develop")
        remote = {line.split()[1]: line.split()[0]
                  for line in git("ls-remote", "origin", "refs/heads/master", "refs/heads/develop").splitlines()}
        require(remote.get("refs/heads/master") == master and remote.get("refs/heads/develop") == develop,
                "remote_refs_differ")
        complete_at(master)
        dev_files = gitops.tree_files(ctx.root, develop, "ai-logs/snapshots")
        master_files = gitops.tree_files(ctx.root, master, "ai-logs/snapshots")
        require(all(master_files.get(path) == entry for path, entry in dev_files.items()), "develop_logs_missing_in_master")
        require(gitops.is_ancestor(ctx.root, source, master), "source_commit_missing_in_master")
        receipt = {"time": utc_now(), "source_commit": source, "master": master, "develop": develop,
                   "policy_version": engine.build_policy(ctx).version, "remote_refs_verified": True,
                   "completeness": True, "secret_findings": 0, "develop_snapshot_files": len(dev_files),
                   "develop_snapshots_identical_in_master": True, "final_submission": True}
        (HERE / "submission-receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print(json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        require(sys.argv[1:] in (["--check"], ["--apply"]), "usage: --check or --apply")
        plan = json.loads((HERE / "handoff-plan.json").read_bytes())
        if sys.argv[1] == "--check":
            print(json.dumps(preflight(plan)))
        else:
            apply(plan)
    except Exception as exc:
        # Keep originals and any successfully created commits. Never automatically undo.
        print("Stopped: " + (str(exc) if isinstance(exc, RuntimeError) else type(exc).__name__), file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)
"}}

def _record_error(ctx: Context, tool: str, event: str, error: str, where: str = "-") -> None:
    try:

def _read_stdin_json() -> dict:
    stream = sys.stdin
    if stream is None or stream.isatty():
        return {}
    raw = stream.buffer.read() if hasattr(stream, "buffer") else stream.read().encode()
    raw = raw.removeprefix(b"\xef\xbb\xbf")  # 셸 설정에 따라 붙는 UTF-8 BOM
    if not raw.strip():
        return {}
    try:
        o = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
    except ValueError:
        return {"_invalid_input": True}
    return o if isinstance(o, dict) else {}


def _register(ctx: Context, tool: str, event: str, payload: dict) -> None:

def file_lock(path: str, timeout: float = 60.0, stale_after: float = 0.0):
    """소유자(pid·시작 시각·nonce)를 기록하는 O_EXCL 파일 잠금.

    - 해제는 자기 nonce일 때만 한다. 같은 프로세스 안에서는 재진입할 수 있다.
    """
    key = os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(path))
    with _held_mutex:
        if key in _held:
            _held[key][1] += 1
            reentrant = True
        else:
            reentrant = False
    if reentrant:
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            with _held_mutex:
                _held[key][1] -= 1
                if _held[key][1] == 0:
                    del _held[key]
        return
    ensure_dir(os.path.dirname(path))
    nonce = uuid.uuid4().hex
    start = time.time()
    while True:
        try:
            fd = os.open(path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
        except FileExistsError:
            _try_reclaim(path)
            if time.time() - start > timeout:
                raise LockTimeout(os.path.basename(path)) from None
            time.sleep(0.1)
            continue
        try:
            os.write(fd, json.dumps(_my_owner(nonce)).encode())
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        break
    with _held_mutex:
        _held[key] = [nonce, 1]
    try:
        yield
    finally:

        if isinstance(owner, dict) and owner.get("nonce") == nonce:

    stream = sys.stdin
    if stream is None or stream.isatty():

    raw = stream.buffer.read() if hasattr(stream, "buffer") else stream.read().encode()
    raw = raw.removeprefix(b"\xef\xbb\xbf")  # 셸 설정에 따라 붙는 UTF-8 BOM

#### Configure installed server policy

After installation, users can enable or disable a bundled MCP server and tune tool approval policy from their Codex config without editing the plugin. Use `plugins.<plugin>.mcp_servers.<server>` for plugin-scoped MCP server policy:
    
    `[plugins."my-plugin".mcp_servers.docs]
    enabled = true
    default_tools_approval_mode = "prompt"
    enabled_tools = ["search"]
    
    [plugins."my-plugin".mcp_servers.docs.tools.search]
    approval_mode = "approve"`

When your plugin is enabled, the Codex runtime can load lifecycle hooks from your plugin alongside user, project, and managed hooks. This includes ChatGPT Work and Codex. Hook scripts must exist in the execution environment; installing a plugin on the web doesn’t deploy them. Enterprise admins can deploy required scripts through mobile device management (MDM).

Installing or enabling a plugin doesn’t automatically trust its hooks. Plugin-bundled hooks are non-managed hooks, so Codex skips them until the user reviews and trusts the current hook definition.

Codex discovers `hooks/hooks.json` by default when the selected OpenAI extension or compatibility manifest doesn’t define `hooks`:
    
    `{
      "hooks": {
        "SessionStart": [
          {
            "hooks": [
              {
                "type": "command",
                "command": "python3 ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_start.py",
                "statusMessage": "Loading plugin context"
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    }`

To override that default, define `hooks` inside `extensions.com.openai` in root `plugin.json`. The field can be a single path, an array of paths, an inline hooks object, or an array of inline hooks objects. An explicit value replaces default-file discovery; it doesn’t add to `hooks/hooks.json`.
    
    `{
      "$schema": "https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json",
      "name": "repo-policy",
      "extensions": {
        "com.openai": {
          "hooks": ["./hooks/session.json", "./hooks/tools.json"]
        }
      }
    }`

Legacy packages can declare `hooks` directly in `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`.

Hook paths start with `./`, resolve relative to the plugin root, and stay inside the plugin root.

Plugin hook commands receive the Codex-specific environment variables `PLUGIN_ROOT` and `PLUGIN_DATA`. `PLUGIN_ROOT` points to the installed plugin root, and `PLUGIN_DATA` points to the plugin’s writable data directory. Codex also sets `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA` for compatibility with existing plugin hooks.

Plugin hooks use the same event schema as regular hooks. See Hooks on Learn for supported events, inputs, outputs, trust review, and current limitations.

# Plugin architecture

Understand how plugins combine skills, MCP servers, and optional UI.

Copy Page

Plugins are the packages people discover, install, share, and publish in ChatGPT and Codex. A plugin can contain:

  * Skills that give the model instructions and resources for repeatable workflows.
  * An MCP server that exposes tools and connects to external systems.
  * Both skills and an MCP server when the model needs workflow guidance and server-backed capabilities.
  * Lifecycle hooks that run commands at configured points in the Codex runtime, including ChatGPT Work and Codex.

ChatGPT and Codex share one universal plugin directory. When you publish a public plugin, people can discover the same listing from supported surfaces in either product. Individual capabilities can still be surface-specific; for example, hook scripts must be available in the execution environment. Installing a plugin on the web doesn’t deploy those scripts. See bundled hooks for setup and trust requirements.

class TaskTests(Base):
    git_repo = True

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        engine.ensure_local_exclude(self.ctx)
        self.p = self.claude("tk", prompt_rec("a"), answer_rec("b"), END)

    def msg(self, title="작업"):
        return f"[AI-LOG-009] {title}\n\n  내용\n"

    def write(self, name, text):
        with open(os.path.join(self.env.root, name), "w") as f:
            f.write(text)

    def test_tasks_wait_for_idle_then_run_in_order(self):
        e = self.env
        base = gitops.rev(e.root, "HEAD")
        self.write("a.txt", "1\n")
        self.assertTrue(tasks.reserve(self.ctx, "commit", {"paths": ["a.txt"], "message": self.msg("a")})["ok"])
        self.assertTrue(tasks.reserve(self.ctx, "squash", {"onto": base, "message": self.msg("합침")})["ok"])
        self.assertTrue(tasks.reserve(self.ctx, "stage-log", {"task": "AI-LOG-009", "stage": "1단계"})["ok"])
        self.append(self.p, prompt_rec("next", 2))  # 진행 중인 턴
        r = tasks.run_pending(self.ctx)
        self.assertEqual(r["reason"], "ai_turn_not_idle")
        self.assertEqual(gitops.rev(e.root, "HEAD"), base)
        self.append(self.p, answer_rec("c"), END)
        self.write("b.txt", "2\n")  # 예약 뒤 수정한 파일은 경로에 없으므로 커밋에 들어가지 않는다
        r = tasks.run_pending(self.ctx)
        self.assertEqual(r["reason"], "ok", r)
        log = e.git("log", "--format=%s", f"{base}..HEAD").splitlines()
        self.assertEqual(log, ["[AI-LOG-009] 세션 로그 스냅샷 (1단계)", "[AI-LOG-009] 합침"])
        self.assertIn("b.txt", e.git("status", "--porcelain"))
        self.assertTrue(e.git("for-each-ref", "refs/ai-logging/backup/").strip())

    def test_task_refuses_on_staged_changes_without_touching_index(self):
        e = self.env
        self.write("a.txt", "1\n")
        tasks.reserve(self.ctx, "commit", {"paths": ["a.txt"], "message": self.msg()})
        self.write("u.txt", "u\n")
        e.git("add", "u.txt")
        r = tasks.run_pending(self.ctx)
        self.assertEqual(r["reason"], "staged_changes_present")
        self.assertIn("u.txt", e.git("diff", "--cached", "--name-only"))
        self.assertEqual(tasks.listing(self.ctx)[0]["status"], "failed")
        self.assertEqual(tasks.run_pending(self.ctx)["reason"], "blocked_by_failed_task")

    def test_task_refuses_when_head_moved(self):
        e = self.env
        self.write("a.txt", "1\n")
        tasks.reserve(self.ctx, "commit", {"paths": ["a.txt"], "message": self.msg()})
        e.git("commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "[AI-TEST-001] other\n\n  x")
        self.assertEqual(tasks.run_pending(self.ctx)["reason"], "head_changed")

    def test_reserve_rejects_bad_message_and_log_paths(self):
        self.assertEqual(tasks.reserve(self.ctx, "commit", {"paths": ["a"], "message": "bad"})["reason"],

        self.assertEqual(tasks.reserve(self.ctx, "commit", {"paths": ["."], "message": self.msg()})["reason"],
                         "path_not_allowed")

    def test_squash_refuses_log_commits_in_range(self):

def _win_start_token(pid: int):
    import ctypes
    from ctypes import wintypes

    k32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
    k32.OpenProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
    k32.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.DWORD]
    k32.GetExitCodeProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.DWORD)]
    k32.GetProcessTimes.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE] + [ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.FILETIME)] * 4
    k32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
    h = k32.OpenProcess(0x1000, False, pid)  # PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION
    if not h:
        return "alive" if ctypes.get_last_error() == 5 else None  # 5 = 접근 거부(살아 있음)
    try:
        code = wintypes.DWORD()
        if not k32.GetExitCodeProcess(h, ctypes.byref(code)) or code.value != 259:  # STILL_ACTIVE
            return None
        times = [wintypes.FILETIME() for _ in range(4)]
        if not k32.GetProcessTimes(h, *[ctypes.byref(t) for t in times]):
            return "alive"
        return str((times[0].dwHighDateTime << 32) | times[0].dwLowDateTime)

# Hooks

Copy Page

Run scripts or MCP tools during the Codex lifecycle

Hooks are an extensibility framework for Codex. They let you run scripts or MCP tools during the agentic loop, enabling features such as:

  * Send the chat to a custom logging/analytics engine
  * Scan your team’s prompts to block accidentally pasting API keys
  * Summarize chats to create persistent memories automatically
  * Run a custom validation check when a chat turn stops, enforcing standards
  * Customize prompting when in a certain directory

How hooks run:

  * Matching hooks from multiple files all run.
  * Multiple matching command hooks for the same event are launched concurrently, so one hook can’t prevent another matching hook from starting.
  * Non-managed hooks must be reviewed and trusted before they run.

Hooks run at different points in a conversation:

When  | Hooks
--- | ---
During a turn  | `PreToolUse`, `PermissionRequest`, `PostToolUse`, `PreCompact`, `PostCompact`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `SubagentStop`, `Stop`
Defaults to `{}`.
`timeout`  | Optional active execution timeout in seconds. Defaults to `600`.
`statusMessage`  | Optional message shown while the hook runs.

### Expand arguments from the hook event

Use `${field.nested}` to read a dotted field from the hook event. A placeholder that fills an entire value keeps its JSON type. A placeholder inside a larger string is rendered as text. Codex expands objects and arrays recursively.

For an event containing `{"tool_input":{"file_path":"src/main.rs","count":3}}`, this argument template:
    
    `{
      "path": "${tool_input.file_path}",
      "count": "${tool_input.count}",
      "message": "Scanning ${tool_input.file_path}"
    }`

becomes:
    
    `{
      "path": "src/main.rs",
      "count": 3,
      "message": "Scanning src/main.rs"

### Execution and lifecycle

  * Hooks use an existing MCP connection. They don’t start or reconnect servers.
  * A hook can block an operation when the tool returns a blocking decision. Errors, missing servers, and unavailable tools don’t block the operation.
  * MCP tool hooks run synchronously. They don’t request tool approval or trigger other hooks.
  * The shorter hook or server timeout applies. Time spent waiting for an MCP elicitation response doesn’t count against the timeout.
  * `SessionStart` hooks can run before an MCP server is ready. If that happens, they don’t block the session.
  * `SessionEnd` doesn’t support MCP tool hooks.

## Turn hooks off

Hooks are enabled by default. To turn them off in `config.toml`, set:
    
    `[features]
    hooks = false`

Use `hooks` as the feature key. `codex_hooks` still works as a deprecated alias. Admins can force hooks off the same way in `requirements.toml` with `[features].hooks = false`.

## Run hooks in the background

By default, Codex waits for a command hook to finish before continuing the operation that triggered it. Set `async` to `true` to run a command hook in the background while Codex continues.

### Configure a background hook

Add `"async": true` to a command handler in `hooks.json`:
    
    `{
      "hooks": {
        "PostToolUse": [
          {
            "matcher": "Bash",
            "hooks": [
              {
                "type": "command",
                "command": "python3 ~/.codex/hooks/post_tool_use.py",
                "async": true,
                "timeout": 120
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    }`

For an inline hook in `config.toml`, set `async = true`:
    
    `[[hooks.PostToolUse]]
    matcher = "Bash"
    
    [[hooks.PostToolUse.hooks]]
    type = "command"
    command = "python3 ~/.codex/hooks/post_tool_use.py"
    async = true
    timeout = 120`

Background hooks use the same input, matcher, trust review, timeout, and large-output handling as synchronous command hooks. As with other command hooks, `timeout` is measured in seconds and defaults to `600`. `Interrupt` hooks use a one-second default and a three-second maximum, including when they run in the background.

### How background hooks run

When a background hook finishes, Codex delivers supported informational output at the next safe point in the conversation:

  * If a turn is active, Codex waits for the current model request and tool calls to finish, then makes the output available to the next model request in that turn.
  * If no turn is active, Codex waits until the next user turn. Finishing a background hook doesn’t start a new turn.

Use the same event-specific JSON output as a synchronous hook. Codex adds `additionalContext` to the model’s context and surfaces `systemMessage` as a warning.

Background hooks can’t block, approve, rewrite, or otherwise control the operation that triggered them. Use synchronous hooks for tool policies, permission decisions, prompt rejection, or turn continuation.

  * Codex runs up to eight background hooks concurrently per session. Additional hooks wait until a running hook finishes.
  * Each matching invocation runs independently, and background hooks can finish in a different order than they started.
  * When the session ends, Codex cancels unfinished background hooks and discards output that hasn’t been delivered.
  * `SessionEnd` hooks always run synchronously.

def _win_start_token(pid: int):
    import ctypes
    from ctypes import wintypes

    k32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
    k32.OpenProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
    k32.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.DWORD]
    k32.GetExitCodeProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.DWORD)]
    k32.GetProcessTimes.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE] + [ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.FILETIME)] * 4
    k32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
    h = k32.OpenProcess(0x1000, False, pid)  # PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION
    if not h:
        return "alive" if ctypes.get_last_error() == 5 else None  # 5 = 접근 거부(살아 있음)
    try:
        code = wintypes.DWORD()
        if not k32.GetExitCodeProcess(h, ctypes.byref(code)) or code.value != 259:  # STILL_ACTIVE
            return None
        times = [wintypes.FILETIME() for _ in range(4)]
        if not k32.GetProcessTimes(h, *[ctypes.byref(t) for t in times]):
            return "alive"
        return str((times[0].dwHighDateTime << 32) | times[0].dwLowDateTime)
    finally:
        k32.CloseHandle(h)

L1132: ## MCP tool hooks
L1133: 
L1134: An MCP tool hook lets a lifecycle event call a tool on an already-connected MCP server. It sends structured arguments directly to the tool and uses the same trust review and output contract as a command hook.

L1147:                 "tool": "scan_patch",

L1149:                 "timeout": 30,

L1151:               }

L990: Codex can also discover hooks bundled with enabled plugins. Plugin-bundled hooks load alongside other hook sources and use the same trust-review flow as other non-managed hooks.
L991: 
L992: Project-local hooks load only when the project `.codex/` layer is trusted. In untrusted projects, Codex still loads user and system hooks from their own active config layers.
L993: ## Review and trust hooks
L994: 
L995: Codex lists configured hooks before deciding which ones can run. Before a non-managed hook can run, Codex requires you to review and trust the exact hook definition. Codex records trust against the hook’s current hash, so new or changed hooks are marked for review and skipped until trusted.

"""Exercise pending-task recovery on disposable repositories only."""
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import main, mock

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests"))
from test_guard_snapshots import Base, END, answer_rec, prompt_rec
from ailog import engine, gitops, snapshot, tasks, turns

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("handoff", Path(__file__).with_name("finish-submission.py"))
handoff = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(handoff)


class HandoffTests(Base):
    git_repo = True

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        engine.ensure_local_exclude(self.ctx)
        self.env.git("branch", "-m", "develop")
        self.env.git("branch", "feature/REVIEW-002")
        self.p = self.claude("handoff", prompt_rec("a"), answer_rec("b"), END)
        self.task = tasks.reserve(self.ctx, "stage-log", {"task": "REVIEW-002", "stage": "recovery"})["id"]
        self.plan = {"pending_log_tasks": [self.task]}
        self.patch = mock.patch.object(handoff, "ctx", self.ctx)
        self.patch.start()
        self.addCleanup(self.patch.stop)

    def test_resumes_pending_log_and_is_idempotent(self):
        base = gitops.rev(self.env.root, "HEAD")
        with turns.guard_lock(self.ctx):
            handoff.finish_pending_logs(self.plan)
        committed = gitops.rev(self.env.root, "HEAD")
        self.assertNotEqual(base, committed)
        self.assertEqual(tasks.listing(self.ctx)[0]["status"], "done")
        self.assertTrue(snapshot.completeness(self.ctx, "HEAD")["complete"])
        with turns.guard_lock(self.ctx):
            handoff.finish_pending_logs(self.plan)
        self.assertEqual(gitops.rev(self.env.root, "HEAD"), committed)

    def test_active_turn_cannot_execute_pending_log(self):
        base = gitops.rev(self.env.root, "HEAD")
        self.append(self.p, prompt_rec("next", 2))
        with turns.guard_lock(self.ctx), self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "ai_turn_not_idle"):
            handoff.finish_pending_logs(self.plan)
        self.assertEqual(gitops.rev(self.env.root, "HEAD"), base)
        self.assertEqual(tasks.listing(self.ctx)[0]["status"], "pending")

    def test_unreviewed_task_is_not_run(self):
        other = tasks.reserve(self.ctx, "stage-log", {"task": "REVIEW-002", "stage": "other"})["id"]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "unreviewed_reserved_task:" + other):
            handoff.finish_pending_logs(self.plan)
        self.assertTrue(all(t["status"] == "pending" for t in tasks.listing(self.ctx)))

    def test_failed_task_is_not_retried_automatically(self):
        tasks._mark(self.ctx, self.task, "failed", reason="head_changed")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "reserved_task_failed:.*head_changed"):
            handoff.finish_pending_logs(self.plan)
        self.assertEqual(tasks.listing(self.ctx)[0]["status"], "failed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(verbosity=2)
